task.title: Install the ESP32 Temperature Monitoring System

prereq.p: Ensure that the ESP32 development board is disconnected from the power supply before connecting the components.

step.cmd: Connect the DHT sensor VCC pin to the ESP32 power pin.
Connect the DHT sensor GND pin to the ESP32 ground pin.
Connect the DHT sensor data pin to the configured GPIO pin on the ESP32.
Connect the ESP32 development board to the computer using a USB cable.
Open the project in the Arduino IDE.
Select the appropriate ESP32 board and communication port.
Upload the program to the ESP32 development board.

result.p: The ESP32 starts collecting temperature and humidity readings after the program is successfully uploaded.
